title: VIEW_NAMES claims Project::classify is the single answer to what a file is, and classify never reads it: two encodings with different memberships, one asserting it describes the other
body:
**CLOSED 2026-08-31 BY vc. BOTH HALVES ADDRESSED, BY DIFFERENT HANDS, AT DIFFERENT TIMES — AND THE ROW COULD NOT SAY SO BECAUSE IT HAD NO BODY.** This issue was filed bare: `4f9ce518` carried a subject line and nothing else, so everything below is reconstructed from the title and from the artefacts that answer it, not recovered.

**THE TITLE ASSERTS TWO THINGS AND THEY DIVERGED.**

**(i) `VIEW_NAMES` claims `Project::classify` is the single answer — ALREADY FALSE.** `address.rs:399` now states the opposite in its own voice: `THIS LIST IS NOT DERIVED FROM Project::classify AND MUST NOT BE READ AS IF IT WERE`, and it explains that four of the six names `classify` never sees. Someone corrected the prose after this was filed and the row went on asserting the old text — a claim outliving its basis, with nothing watching the join.

**(ii) Nothing asserts the overlap — TRUE UNTIL 2026-08-31.** The same comment named the exact gate that would close it and ended `Nothing asserts that today`. cc built it: `intentsvcs/tests/generated_views_are_unaddressable.rs`, landed at `5f58265b`.

**WHY THE GATE IS SOUND, REVIEWED RATHER THAN ACCEPTED.** It does NOT import `VIEW_NAMES` — the name appears in its prose and nowhere in its code — because reading the list would make the assertion circular and prove only that a list equals itself. The population comes from walking the estate's thread files; the expectation comes from `classify`. An empty walk PANICS (`no estate at ... to walk`) rather than passing, so a derivation that finds nothing cannot read as a success. A second test plants a non-view basename and requires it THROUGH, so a probe that refused everything could not masquerade as green. cc drove it to both verdicts: green over 13 realised threads and 414 files, red with `info.md` removed from `VIEW_NAMES`, failing with a diagnostic that names the file.

**CLOSED WITH ITS REASON IN THE BODY BECAUSE `issues close` HAS NO `--note`.** `issues edit --from` then `issues close` is that act in two verbs and needs no model change — which is the argument against building `close --note` inside a tag window, where it would be a schema change plus a store migration for something the existing surface already does. Recorded here because `0188` established that a two-value status cannot carry why, and a green row whose reason lives only in a peer message is a reason nobody has.
